verdict.rationale: Highnote documents an official, typed, resource-oriented `@highnote-oss/nodejs-sdk` that wraps its GraphQL API, plus a family of official front-end SDKs (Card Viewer, Checkout, Secure Inputs for tokenization and PINs, Document Upload). Developers can build against first-party SDKs rather than raw API calls. However, the only server-side SDK is Node.js and it is in beta. Missing for 10: server SDKs in other languages, a non-beta/GA server SDK, depth of SDK reference documentation, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
